body: Great work on the join flow! I left a couple of inline suggestions regarding security and React best practices.

comments.body: Using `select('*')` retrieves the `password_hash` column to the client. This allows potential attackers to harvest hashes. It is safer to use a computed boolean column (e.g., `has_password`) or a secure view so hashes never leave the database.
Calling `window.location.reload()` disrupts the SPA experience and clears local state. Consider passing an `onUpdate` callback or mutating the local state to trigger a re-render instead.
